title: Add Agentica as a provider to Kilo Code.
author: ccocks

test_results.reason: PR is in CONFLICTING state per GitHub API; cannot merge or build. Merge conflicts must be resolved before testing.

lessons: Type shim replacement (re-export -> inline copy) is an architectural red flag in monorepo PRs
Model data should have a single source of truth, not three copies with inconsistent values
Large provider PRs (6000+ lines) benefit from decomposition into core/auth/UI/plans
Always check for committed development artifacts (diff files, build outputs)
Handler model ID field must match the modelIdKeysByProvider registration
blocking_issues: ExtensionMessage.ts and WebviewMessage.ts replaced with 1600+ line inline copies (breaks monorepo type architecture)
Committed development artifacts: cline_full_diff.txt, diff.txt, github_diff.txt
Model data triplicated with inconsistent maxTokens and pricing values
Handler reads apiModelId instead of agenticaModelId (model selection broken)
Password dual-storage: plaintext in global state AND in secure storage
Unrelated behavior changes: auto-approve defaults, maxReadFileLine, HTML formatting
